notes.text:
This update for giflib fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-23868: double-free result of a shallow copy can lead to memory corruption (bsc#1259502).

notes.text: Giflib contains a double-free vulnerability that is the result of a shallow copy in GifMakeSavedImage and incorrect error handling. The conditions needed to trigger this vulnerability are difficult but may be possible.
